answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The summit graph is validated at intake and the kernel frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and willow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1493 impostors cost 670 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
